craft_notes: Sthāyin: dakṣiṇā and sating. Rows: mind, fee, sate. Read aloud: giving.

lines: Mantra-heart unceasing mind thou — thus the pupil, hearing, bowing,
owning, to the master, with fee to wife-and-wealth-and-frame,
l4.sanskrit_cite: mantrahṛdayam anavarataṃ smaret ity evaṃ śiṣyaḥ śrutvā praṇamya abhyupagamya guruṃ dhanadāraśarīraparyantayā dakṣiṇayā paritoṣya pūrvadīkṣitāṃś ca dīnānāthādikān tarpayet
